about_the_game:
This star-studded DLC Pack contains each playable Superstar below and their MyFACTION cards:

Chris Sabin

Alex Shelley

Giulia

Stephanie Vaquer

Plus, a special celebrity guest to be announced

The New Wave Pack is a part of the WWE 2K25 Season Pass, which is included in both the Deadman and The Bloodline Editions.

*Additional Superstar and release date to be announced post-launch. Release date may be subject to change.
